headers.comment: Crawl files must be re-read promptly; an hour-stale sitemap delays every new page.
The share card is content-stable and fetched by every social scraper.

Baseline security headers. Deliberately NO X-Frame-Options: being embeddable in Canvas, Moodle and slide decks is a documented feature of this site (docs/educator_guide.md), so framing must stay open. There is nothing to clickjack - no accounts act on a user's behalf, and progress is per-browser.
